narrative_shape: Implementation run with one performance detour. Early turns include waits for pytest background notifications (T70-73, T87-88). Around T100-102 a slow dry-run scan over ~134M nodes prompts a hot-path optimisation of node() and way(); then background_all is implemented (T114-120) and the suite passes (227, T131), followed by scope check and commit/push (T134). Edit count rises 5->16 across the prefix.

early_signals.signal: Waits on pytest background notification rather than polling (T70, T73)
Dry-run scan is slow (extra ~255s from node scan); waits again
Diagnoses the hot path (134M nodes without place tag) and applies a targeted optimisation, reruns
Edits 12 and reads 21 by T120: balanced implement-and-read loop; only 2 compactions

rationale: Balanced read/edit/test progression; the slow scan is diagnosed and fixed rather than repeated. Waits are bounded. No sign of thrash or a pivot before T120.
